Patch Set 1:

(8 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Experimental feature testing in progress, please pay attention to the comments

Some concerns, see inline comments. One point that isn't tied to a single line: init_facet_vars() returns immediately when $CLIENTONLY is set (test-framework.sh:6070), so `auster -C` / `--client-only` - the mode documented as "Run client-side sanity tests against an already setup filesystem" - still ends up with mds1_svc/ost1_svc/mgs_svc unset and will keep hitting "No label for mds1!". Is that configuration meant to be covered by this fix, or only `-N`?

commit.subject: LU-20499 tests: fix "No label for mdsN" when running auster on existing filesystem
commit.message:
LU-20499 tests: fix "No label for mdsN" when running auster on existing filesystem

- `setup_if_needed()` never called `init_facets_vars` when skipping
setup (`-N` flag) or when the filesystem was already mounted, leaving
`mdsN_svc`/`ostN_svc`/`mgs_svc` variables unset
- `convert_facet2label()` then failed with `"No label for mds1!"` for
any test that looked up a service label
- Fix: call `init_facets_vars` in both early-return paths (the `-N` path
and the already-mounted path); also move the `! do_setup` check after
the `nfs_client_mode` guard to preserve existing guard ordering

TLC-Bug: TLU-106
